page_title: EVE 0-1 ARS | Everton v Arsenal 20/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Samuel Barrott is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+1' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Mikel Merino (Arsenal) is thwarted and cleared to safety. It will be a corner kick for Arsenal.
89' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
88' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
88' Mikel Arteta prepares a substitution. Martin Odegaard is replaced by Mikel Merino (Arsenal).
86' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 4:4.
80' Substitution. Leandro Trossard did his best and is replaced by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal).
78' Merlin Rohl (Everton) latches on to an accurate cross on the edge of the penalty box and sends the ball towards goal, but it's too easy for the keeper.
76' David Moyes decides to make a substitution. Carlos Alcaraz will be replaced by Merlin Rohl (Everton).
75' Today's match ends for Dwight McNeil who will be replaced by Tyler Dibling (Everton).
73' Dwight McNeil (Everton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to David Raya, who smothers the ball.
71' James Garner (Everton) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
69' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
69' Post! Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) latches on to a sweet pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which only hits the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
68' 3:10 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:2.
66' David Moyes has decided to substitute Thierno Barry and he is replaced by Beto (Everton).
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Viktor Gyökeres leaves the pitch and Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) comes on.

64' OFF THE POST! Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the right post! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
62' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
59' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Everton, play can continue.

58' Play continues despite the shouts by some Everton players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Samuel Barrott interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
58' PENALTY APPEAL after Thierno Barry (Everton) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
56' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) unnecessarily kicks the ball off the pitch. Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
55' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) tries to find Dwight McNeil, but he puts too much power on the pass. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Arsenal.

54' A through ball from Dwight McNeil (Everton) fails to reach Carlos Alcaraz as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Carlos Alcaraz could have got into a promising position.
52' Thierno Barry (Everton) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
51' What a great touch by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
51' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
48' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
46' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) runs onto a good ball played into the box and hits a first-time screamer towards goal, but a defender somehow gets his body in the way and makes the block.
46' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+7' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) passes the ball onto Thierno Barry, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
45+6' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) reacts quickest to a cross from Viktor Gyökeres, but slams his header well wide of the left post from around the penalty spot.
45+4' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
45+1' The game is interrupted now, Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) latches onto a short pass from William Saliba inside the box, but clips his shot high over the bar.
43' Arsenal control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
41' Declan Rice (Arsenal) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
39' James Tarkowski (Everton) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
37' Arsenal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
34' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
32' Samuel Barrott blows for a foul after Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
31' 0:3 – the total goal attempt statistics. The shots on goal statistics – 0:1.
30' David Raya displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after James Garner (Everton) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
27' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Jordan Pickford no chance!
27' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) is going to take the penalty!
26' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
26' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Arsenal!
24' Referee Samuel Barrott makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Arsenal. Let’s see what happens!
24' Jake O'Brien (Everton) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
24' Declan Rice flicks on the near post corner to Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) at the back post, but he somehow heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range.
24' There's an opportunity for Declan Rice (Arsenal) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
23' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
23' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Arsenal force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

20' Jordan Pickford doesn't have to worry about that one. Martin Odegaard puts a cross in towards Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal), who is unable to keep his header on target from the centre of the box. He sends the ball well wide of the left post.
19' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal), but his powerful first-time effort flies high over the bar.
16' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
16' Ball possession – 42:58.
15' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
14' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Dwight McNeil (Everton) sends it out of play. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
13' Jake O'Brien (Everton) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
13' James Garner (Everton) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
11' It could have been a good chance to score! Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) fails to release Viktor Gyökeres with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
10' A cross from Dwight McNeil (Everton) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
6' Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) sends a long cross over to Jurrien Timber, but Jordan Pickford comes forward to gather the ball.
5' Jack Grealish (Everton) tries to find Vitali Mykolenko, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
2' The Everton players are exchanging some short passes.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Arsenal will kick the game off.
Samuel Barrott got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
